question: Who among the following became the first Indian to win the Miss Deaf World title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vidisha Baliyan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vidisha Baliyan__ became the first Indian to win the** Miss Deaf World title.**
 
• Vidisha Baliyan is an Indian female deaf model and a retired tennis player.
 
• She wins the Miss Deaf World title in 2019.
 
• She is from Uttar Pradesh's Muzzafarnagar city.
 
• She has represented India at the 2017 Summer Deaflympics and at the 2019 Miss & Mister Deaf World contest.
 
• She also won the title of Miss Deaf India in February 2019 in Assam, Guwahati.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Arunima Sinha is the World's first female amputee to scale Mount Everest, Mount Kilimanjaro (Tanzania), Mount Elbrus (Russia), Mount Kosciusko (Australia), and Mount Aconcagua (South America), Carstensz Pyramid (Indonesia), and Mount Vinson.
 
• Preethi Srinivasan was a cricket player for the Tamil Nadu women's cricket team.
 
• **Raghavi Shankar **is founder of started **The Headway Foundation** and the aim is to help, mentor, and encourage the disabled.
